opening.argument: The presentation gives concrete, observable instructions for entering an Intel motherboard's BIOS and changing boot-device priority. The speaker explains that the tutorial will show viewers how to "go into the BIOS and change the boot sequence," then directs them to the boot section and identifies the keyboard controls for moving devices up and down. The screen correspondingly displays BIOS boot settings and a boot-device selection menu. The speaker also explains how to save the revised settings, while the Micro Center Tech branding and website outro frame the material as organizational technical support rather than an unclear solicitation.

citations.quote: Today I want to show you how to go into the BIOS and change the boot sequence
To change that, hit Enter, and the minus key or the shift plus key to move the device up and down, changing the priority of the boot.
